contradictions: Long-term capacity expansion thesis coexists with materially weaker first-half revenue and adjusted EBITDA.

The company is expanding localized/modular capacity while first-half 2026 revenue and utilization are materially weaker; the contradiction is economically reconcilable if delayed customer ramps recover, but current cited evidence does not establish that timing.

edges.falsifier: OEM delays persist or competing suppliers/chemistries win the targeted platforms

edges.falsifier: utilization remains weak and gross margins compress despite added capacity
